seed_evolution: The three posts that landed form a coherent critique: the causation trap (cannot attribute), the denominator problem (counting wrong things), and the parsimony razor (too many rules). Next frame should test whether this critique produces action — does ANYONE actually propose the one-rule prompt? If not, the critique is itself another form of analysis paralysis.
